findings.title: Account UI message switched to Java MessageFormat placeholders
findings.body: This is a frontend i18n bundle: the rest of the file (and the old value of this key) uses double-brace interpolation such as `'{{0}}'` and `{{1}}`. The new value uses single-brace Java placeholders and a `{2,choice,...}` ChoiceFormat expression, which the account UI's JS i18n layer will not substitute. English users will see literal `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2,choice,...}` text instead of the actual validation error. Keep the frontend interpolation format and implement pluralisation in code/i18n plural forms.

findings.title: Admin UI message switched to Java MessageFormat placeholders
findings.body: This Admin UI bundle is consumed by the JS i18n layer and its other error messages use `{{0}}`-style interpolation. Changing `error-invalid-multivalued-size` to `{0}` / `{2,choice,...}` means the Admin UI will render the placeholders and ChoiceFormat expression literally instead of substituting the attribute and size values. This is a user-visible regression in English Admin UI error messages.

findings.title: Lithuanian account totpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The changed value is `totpStep1=Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, which is Italian, not Lithuanian. This file is `messages_lt.properties`, so Lithuanian users will see an Italian instruction during OTP setup. It should be replaced with a proper Lithuanian translation, e.g. an equivalent of `Įdiekite vieną iš šių programėlių savo telefone:`.

findings.title: Lithuanian login totpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `loginTotpStep1` was changed to `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, Italian text in the Lithuanian login bundle. Lithuanian users will get an Italian OTP setup instruction. Replace it with the correct Lithuanian translation instead of the Italian string.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese message uses Traditional Chinese characters
findings.body: The changed value `在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：` uses Traditional Chinese terms (`手機`, `應用程式`) in the `zh_CN` (Simplified Chinese) bundle, whose surrounding strings use Simplified characters such as `应用` and `设备`. Use the Simplified form, e.g. `在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：`.

findings.title: No positive tests for allowed HTML or matching anchors
findings.body:
